statement: GPT-5.6 Luna xhigh or max under the exact Codex 0.147.0 realization may retain the bounded landing suitability observed under Codex 0.146.0, but current fit remains a transfer hypothesis until a real external-process regression returns through owner review.

conditions: the target owner and source of truth are explicit
architecture and authority boundaries are already decided
the done state and validators are inspectable
acceptance remains with the target owner and proof route
the exact Codex 0.147.0 realization passes the live catalog check
the bound abyss-stack runtime profile exists and is admitted before launch
exclusions: semantic merge conflicts with materially different futures
autonomous commit, push, merge, release, publication, or other external effects
claims about internal geometry or training data inferred from behavior alone
treating compatibility with the live model catalog as runtime-profile availability or task-fit proof
transferring Codex 0.146.0 outcome evidence to 0.147.0 without a new real-work regression

evidence_refs.notes: The stale predecessor preserves the actual landing trials, independent reviews, counterevidence, and attribution limits. It informs this transfer hypothesis but does not prove current fit.

Owner-source eval selection keeps the current model-work review bounded and separate from landing-fit transfer.
Installed Codex CLI is 0.148.0, so the subject 0.147.0 realization is stale. This closes currentness only and does not establish replacement fit.

known_counterevidence.notes: The Max landing attempt was authority_blocked because workspace_manifest_observation_gap remained unresolved; no landing change was returned.

freshness.policy: The bounded landing-transfer hypothesis is preserved as historical input; its Codex 0.147.0 realizations became stale on the 0.148.0 runtime transition, and a future 0.148.0 regression must re-establish currentness before fit is considered.

history.reason: A live Codex 0.147.0 catalog observation plus bounded 0.146.0 landing evidence justify a new regression candidate, not transferred proof.

The exact Codex 0.147.0 realizations became stale when the installed Codex CLI advanced to 0.148.0. The bounded transfer hypothesis is retained, but no replacement 0.148.0 fit or landing evidence is admitted by this transition.

The stale Codex 0.146.0 claim preserves relevant evidence but does not prove behavior or net benefit under 0.147.0.
